title: Create Aeronautics: Survival Physics Staff
description: This mod adds a new survival physics staff similar to the creative one, it utilizes backtank sir pressure for usage.
body:
# Survival Physics Staff 
![floating of oak planks using the staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de017aedf29ee36b7436274eea8e6c7358981a1e.png)
## Physics Staff 
Physics Staff adds a survival-friendly version of Create Aeronautics’ Creative Physics Staff.

The staff can freeze and control physics sublevels just like the original creative item, but it is balanced around Create’s backtank system. You must wear a backtank containing air for the staff to work, and air is continuously consumed for every object you keep frozen.

The durability bar on the staff displays the remaining air in your equipped backtank. When the backtank becomes empty, is removed, or the player disconnects, any objects frozen by that player are automatically released.

The staff has its own creative tab, custom texture, and a large Mechanical Crafter recipe designed to fit naturally into Create’s progression.  
  
  Features:-
1. Freeze and move Create Aeronautics physics sublevels
2. Requires air from a worn Create backtank
3. Staff durability bar shows remaining backtank air
4. Air drains continuously for each frozen object
5. Frozen objects are released when air runs out or the backtank is removed
6. Uses a Mechanical Crafter recipe designed for survival progression
